About us

Taxes for the self-employed, explained properly.

Fisco Perfetto exists for people who work for themselves and do not want to lose time among forms, deadlines and acronyms. We combine tax advice and digital tools to follow your registration, invoices, taxes and contributions.

Our goal is simple: let you always know what you owe, when and why, without having to become a tax expert.

How we work

1Clarity first

We explain regimes, rates and contributions with examples on your own figures, so you decide with facts, not hearsay.

2Digital, but with people

Documents and invoices online, answers from a person who knows your case and not from an automated responder.

3Eyes on deadlines

An always-current tax calendar warns you ahead of F24 payments, advance payments and returns.
